Explosion injures three South Korean officers near North Korean border

An explosion near the heavily fortified border between North and South Korea has injured three South Korean military officers. Two of the injured officers were evacuated by helicopter, while the third was expected to be transported by road before being airlifted. Local media reports suggest the incident may have been caused by a landmine.
